configuration.excluded: human occupant / ATD for this first six-function proof article

why_minimum: 100 is required as a controlled structural reaction boundary.
110L+110R are both mandatory because bilateral load path is itself a core hypothesis; a single-side rig cannot prove bilateral load sharing/torsional control.
120 is the moving carriage required for controlled longitudinal translation.
130 is required to demonstrate the energy-management path.
150L+150R and 160 are required to demonstrate the separate seatback-rotation path.
170 is required to demonstrate state transition/constraint behavior.
180 is required to demonstrate rebound control.
210 is required to make the critical states and motion measurable/reproducible.
what_it_can_prove: Bilateral guided carriage architecture at development-rig level
Controlled longitudinal translation at bench level
Existence/function of an explicit energy-management interface
State-machine mechanical transition at development-model level
Measured mechanical kinematics and reaction channels
what_it_cannot_prove: Crash safety or occupant injury reduction
source_basis: The first physical article master explicitly defines P0-E/V0 as a non-occupant integrated exploratory mechanism and lists the core real hardware modules; the full architecture separately retains 140/190/200 for pelvic/occupant interfaces. fileciteturn32file0L1-L10 fileciteturn32file1L1-L11
